title: Princess Cordelia
desc: What simple description could attempt to summarize the extraordinary life of Princess Cordelia of Royal House Thebe? A poetic soul who enjoyed the ocean, the company of pirate suitors, painting, jazz, carpentry, and adventure—yet, lost the home she so loved in a terrible invasion. A woman who not only survived a Kraken attack but used its power for her own purposes. Few Sims can rival her story. #MaxisCreates #PrincessCordelia #CordeliaThebe #LongJohnButtercups #ChazMacFreeling #RodrigoDePablo

title: Tristen Palmer
desc: Tristen grew up an only child in Brindleton Bay. Despite being a quiet Sim, rural life never appealed to Tristen, so he moved to the city the first chance he got. Will his sarcastic wit shine through and help him make new friends despite being a loner? Who knows! But if not, a dog or cat are always an option... maybe even a roommate! #MaxisCreates #TristenPalmer #2018Sims

title: Kasen Henry
desc: There are those who might say Kasen is a bit materialistic... He'd say he has good taste (but let's face it, they wouldn't be wrong). Designer shirt $300 Simoleons. Designer Glasses: $450 Simoleons. His haircut: $200 Simoleons. Maybe someday he will achieve his goals of becoming a famous DJ, but for now... he's glad to just look good. #MaxisCreates #KasenHenry #2018Sims

title: Valeria Lopez
desc: While Valeria spent her early years with her mother's family in Japan, she left with her mom and dad to travel the world for her father's research work when she was still young. They haven't stopped moving since! Thankfully, she's kept in contact with her best friend, Emiko Mori! Now that she's an adult, she needs to figure out what to do with her life: adventure, explore her father's Venezuelan heritage, or take on a new challenge? #MaxisCreates #ValeriaLopez #EmikoMori #2018Sims

title: Kat Jenkins
desc: Quirky, creative, a hopeless romantic... Kat is a sweetheart who has aspirations to chase a career in fashion. Her dark secret: She's obsessed with dinosaurs and other buried secrets. While part of her would like to give up fashion and pursue archaeology, it's a little out of her comfort zone. For now, she's content to collect as many dino-curios and fossils as she can and display them around the house... or is she? #MaxisCreates #KatJenkins #2018Sims

title: Tommi Turner
desc: Tommi never really liked the name 'Tomasina,' so she's been 'Tommi' as long as she can remember. She's a business professional with big dreams! Unfortunately, she keeps getting passed up for promotions (that Sydney Wright gets). It must be Sydney's quick wit and huge vocabulary! Will a friendship ever develop or is it all downhill from here? #MaxisCreates #TommiTurner #SydneyWright #2018Sims

title: Aliya Fuego
desc: Fashionista, social-climber, party-girl, secret genius. All of that outward materialism–it's mostly a persona. Aliya is exclusive when it comes to her private life and goals. Since she was a little girl, she's dreamed of becoming a Super Villain, hidden in plain view within the dazzling spotlight of Del Sol Valley. She has the brains to pull it off, but can she keep it a secret in such a high-stakes environment? #MaxisCreates #AliyaFuego #2018Sims

title: Marco Russo
desc: Marco is a painter who has never really known what he wants in life. What he does know is that he's happy with a brush in his hand and a cup of coffee at his side. More than anything he likes painting people. Wrinkley Sims, round Sims, youthful Sims, Sims with no hair, Sims with blue hair! He believes distinctions are what make Sims so beautiful, and he wants to capture every small detail. #MaxisCreates #MarcoRusso #2018Sims

title: Kurt Lumberjackson
desc: Kurt comes from an impressive lineage of lumberjacks. While forestry is in his blood, his real passion lies in apiculture (or Beekeeping)! Kurt loves his little bumblies. He even tried to make a shop selling bee products called Kurt's Bees–which didn't go over super well. As long as he's stuck in Granite Falls, he knows he will never get out of the family business, so Kurt is off on an adventure, beyond his comfort zone, to chase his dreams! #MaxisCreates #KurtLumberjackson #BeeKeeper #2018Sims

title: Kierra Tilo
desc: Kierra is your average-run-of-the-mill-heiress who grew up in a beach-mansion. It's hard being Kierra! She's always had to wonder if people don't just like her because of her money, or her hot tub, or her hair. It -is- fabulous! Occasionally, she likes to dress down and pretend to be 'normal.' It doesn't help that her crush Ross Valentin snubs her whenever he gets the chance. He's the only guy that's never been interested! #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #KierraTilo #RossValentin

title: Brent Hong
desc: Fashion-forward. A bit cocky. A family man. Oh, and evil. Brent dreams of world-domination—preferably from his own private Island where he eats kalua barbecue and lives with his mum and the future Mrs. Hong. Though his love for Kierra Tilo is no secret, he's noticed she only has eyes for another. Will this development put a halt to his plans for world-domination or will the young villain find a way to preserver and build his evil empire? #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #BrentHong #KierraTilo

title: Kaiden Bryant
desc: A bit of a flirt, Kaiden is a sweetie looking for genuine connections. He's easily likeable and not afraid to show off his silly side. Kaiden's biggest flaw: he's a little too obsessed with Thorne Bailey's music. (It horrifies his friends when he shows up dressed like Thorne to parties.) Even still, Kaiden hopes he can overcome his timidity and make it big in the entertainment business just like his role-model. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #KaidenBryant #ThorneBailey

title: Emiko Mori
desc: To Emiko, duality is a lifestyle. She's both cutesy and rebellious. Sweet and tough. Her pastimes include: playing with dolls, doing makeup tutorials online, chasing the Flower Bunny (who she adores), and throwing the best parties. Technology is an important aspect of Emiko's life, especially since her childhood best friend, Valeria Lopez, moved away from Japan at a young age. It's allowed them to keep in touch. #MaxisCreates #EmikoMori #ValeriaLopez

title: Gabby Gonzalez
desc: Something of a hipster, Gabby changed her name when 'Gabriela' became the new baby name sensation of the year. She loves going to festivals with friends! Unfortunately, her twin brother Gael regularly tags along, trying to fit in. It's weird, but she loves him. Though she used to be uptight... years of taking care of Gael's messes have mellowed Gabby, and now she'd rather spend a chill evening, listening to the best undiscovered artists. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #GabbyGonzalez #GaelGonzalez

title: Li Loh
desc: Some Sims dream of being a master chef, but not Li Loh. He wants to master the Art of Mixology. Dazzle patrons near and far with fantastical drinks, bizarre concoctions, and gift them with the art of his moves. He's spent years studying, traveled around the world experiencing the drinks of different cultures, and he's ready. Oh, he's ready. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #LiLoh

title: Gael Gonzalez
desc: Gael is a bit clumsy and kind of messy, but he always has the best intentions! So what if he accidentally set his sister's beloved bowler on fire three times? Those things are ridiculously flammable! He thinks his twin sister, Gabby, and her friends are the best, so he regularly tags along—even if they don't have a lot in common. Deep down, what he really wants is to meet a group of buds to watch the next big game together. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #GaelGonzalez #GabbyGonzalez

title: Ross Valentin
desc: For Ross, everything needs to be clean, he doesn't like kids (aka germ-monsters), and he has a quick temper. That said, there was never a Sim who loved doing laundry quite as much, he's great around adults, and he doesn't let interpersonal-relationship problems fester! Perhaps the most frustrating aspect of his life is that spoiled Kierra Tilo won't stop messaging him, and his beloved Brent Hong doesn't know he exists. Such is life! #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #RossValentin #BrentHong #KierraTilo

title: Dela Ostrow
desc: As a kid, Dela lived all over the world, shadowing her mum—a globally sought-after fashion photographer. That experience gave Dela an inherent sense of optimism and a deep entrepreneurial spirit. She recently launched her first fashion line, and her unique pieces and global style is starting to get press. Her girlfriend Mia—a designer in her own right—helps keep her informed of trends outside the fashion industry. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #DelaOstrow #MiaHayes

title: Jayden Armstrong
desc: Jayden is a personal trainer, with an easy and charming approach to life. Starting in childhood, he found camaraderie through sports, and satisfaction through challenging himself to do his best in any physical feat. Ultimately, that's what drew him to his work as a personal trainer. Always curious and down for anything, Jayden's mellow attitude is a great complement to his girlfriend, Zoe—a feisty, outgoing professional dancer. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #JaydenArmstrong #ZoeFlores

title: Hunter Evans
desc: Big hearted and expressive, Hunter is an outspoken activist for the LGBTQIA community; he's passionate about creating space for people to come together and feel supported. He's cultivated a huge social media following, and his followers count on him to document every moment for the world to see. When he's not authoring content for his channel, he partners with his bestie Camille on a nutrition and wellness series. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #HunterEvans #CamilleAbbiza

title: Zoe Flores
desc: Zoe lights up every room she enters. She's been passionate about dance since preschool, and her natural curiosity has led her to explore many difference dance forms and techniques. As a young Latinx woman, family and community are incredibly important to Zoe. She brings her values to life by volunteering as a youth dance teacher at a local community center. Someday, she may even manage to teach her boyfriend Jayden to dance as well! #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #ZoeFlores #JaydenArmstrong

title: Morgan Park
desc: Morgan is all-in, all the time. Driven by her life-long love of sport, Morgan believes life is meant to be lived, not spent behind a desk. She's always up for any adventure her friends suggest, and always pushes herself to do more. With her track and cross-country scholarships, she was always a top performing athlete at university. She's currently training for her first Iron Man competition, which means a lot of time in the pool and on a bike. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #MorganPark

title: Camille Abbiza
desc: Super smart and determined, Camille is passionate about food and nutrition, and how it fuels people in living their best lives. Camille grew up in France, and often visits her relatives in Morocco. Her multicultural background, and passion for building connection through food, has helped inspire the unique flavors of her cuisine. Camille runs a cafe, and is always thinking about testing new recipes on her customers-turned-friends. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #CamilleAbbiza

title: Mia Hayes
desc: With a head for numbers, and a creative eye, Mia splits her time between freelance programmer and artist gigs. Being both a bit of an introvert, and a bit of a rebel, this independence suited her outlook in life. Mia has a unique way of attracting creative, high-energy friends like Noah, and her girlfriend Dela. They love her genuine, almost kid-like enthusiasm. She is the glue that bonds her social circles together. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #MiaHayes #DelaOstrow #NoahMeyer

title: Sydney Wright
desc: With a quick wit and a huge vocabulary, Sydney is quietly competitive, focused, and ambitious. She works at one of the nation's premiere business firms, where she's been promoted twice in under two years. As an only child, Sydney craves the real conversation and deeper connection you get in one-on-one friendships. Ever loyal, with incredibly high standards, Sydney is slow to let people into her inner circle. Once there, you're a friend for life. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #SydneyWright

title: Noah Meyer
desc: Bold and dynamic, Noah is all about using photography & film to evoke emotion and get people talking. Both on and off set, he's happiest when he's calling the shots, or making people laugh. He will admit that he's maybe a little too obsessed with his Simstagram followers, but they've certainly helped expand his career. Witty, confident, and motivated by success, Noah can sometimes come across as having a little too much ego—but it's all in the name of his art. #2019Sims #MaxisCreates #NoahMeyer

title: Sophia Jordan
desc: Sophia is a unique artist, as she's gifted with synesthesia. She's overwhelmed by colors as she walks through the world, which causes her to scurry home and put paint to canvas while images are still vivid in her mind. Though she tends to focus on her art in lieu of a social life, she still holds lingering feelings for Ollie Purdue, who she once had a brief fling with before he settled down. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #SophiaJordan #OlliePurdue

title: Armand DiAggro
desc: Some Sims have taken to avoiding Armand, as his snobbish attitude can rub others the wrong way. In reality, it's a public persona he's developed to hide his sensitive side. In the privacy of his home, he enjoys a good cry in the bathtub to put his emotions at ease. Whenever he's feeling down, he calls his bestie Amber Stein—it's impossible to feel gloomy around her! #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #ArmandDiAggro #AmberStein

title: Babs L'Amour
desc: Babs' time as a Mixologist was the perfect opportunity to meet—and date—a lot of interesting people that came into and out of her life. Ultimately, she fell completely in love with Ollie. After a picturesque wedding (and three beautiful children), she found herself wanting a new line of work away from the bar scene. Turns out, she's had a talent for writing pent up inside her this entire time. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #BabsLAmour #OlliePurdue

title: Cassidy Purdue
desc: From a young age, it was obvious that Cassidy would blossom as a musical prodigy. She would fight with her brother, Ollie, over her need to diligently practice the piano—Ollie just wanted a quiet home to draw in. As a teen, she took up the guitar and quickly mastered that as well. To Cassidy, technology is a bore... She'd much rather spend an afternoon exploring a vintage record store. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #CassidyPurdue #OlliePurdue

title: June Kay
desc: Nothing will deter June from accomplishing her goals in life, even if they are a bit erratic. She once got WAY into woodworking... random, right? But she followed through; months of hard work in the gym built the muscles she needed to carve every piece of furniture in her home from a solid oak tree. Something else she realized she wanted was Steve Fogel—they're an odd couple, but ambition is a trait this pair will never find themselves short of. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #JuneKay #SteveFogel

title: Ollie Purdue
desc: Oh Ollie... He's always been a bit of a dreamer in life. His family worried he was destined to be destitute, his artistic talents going unrecognized. It turned out, he simply needed his muse. While nursing a drink in The Blue Velvet Nightclub one evening, he locked eyes with Babs—his life was never the same again. A whirlwind romance with Babs led to marriage and fatherhood; Ollie would never be called a starving artist again! #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #OlliePurdue #BabsLAmour #CassidyPurdue

title: Holly Vinedal
desc: Holly likes to daydream about becoming a famous country singer, but in reality she's a down home southern girl. From sun up to sun set, you'll find her in the great outdoors—typically with a fishing rod in hand. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #AndreDeSilva

title: Andre DaSilva
desc: Andre is a tough nut to crack. Anyone who works with him recognizes his genius, but his mood swings drive people away. He can go from silly, to embarrassed, to angry in a flash. When he's not staring at his computer screen, he tends to be hatching a mischievous scheme... but it's difficult for him to recognize when his pranks cross the line. Ultimately, it's cute, cuddly, innocent animals that he bonds best with. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #AndreDeSilva

title: George Rivers
desc: George is a buttoned up kind of guy. He keeps his head down, works hard, and wants the world to recognize his vast array of skills. At home though, it's a different story. That's when any noble pursuits get cast aside in favor of junk food and video games. His darkest secret? He keeps voodoo dolls of his friends, observes them from afar, and waits for the perfect opportunity to torment them. His second darkest secret? He wishes he was a cowboy. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #GeorgeRivers

title: Erroll Dowd
desc: Erroll fancies himself a musician, but he really needs a manager to provide better direction to his career. In his last get-famous-quick scheme, he applied to a reality music competition. When he lost in the final episode, his star faded. Ultimately, people just don't remember second place. Ever since then he's overhauled his wardrobe to dress himself just like the producers did on the show, hoping to be recognized around town. Sadly, nobody has yet. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #ErrollDowd

title: Sean Sullivan
desc: For Sean, social norms are there to be broken. Of course, there isn't much to to rebel against in the idyllic neighborhood of Willow Creek, so Sean resorts to... unconventional means... On weekends, he beats children at chess in the park (cheating, if necessary.) He once made out with an elder, just to freak out his mom. He loves to self quote himself; his favorite being, "I eat plaid for breakfast. Spikeburgers for lunch. No authority for dessert." #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #SeanSullivan

title: Amber Stein
desc: Amber's a lovable goof who puts a smile on the face of anyone she encounters. As a self-professed comedian, she even manages to practice her set on occasion at local lounges. In fact, that's where she met Armand. There he was in the audience, in one of his moods, trying to get cheered up... There she was, telling bad jokes on the stage, and dancing awkwardly. They immediately hit it off, and have been best friends ever since! #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #AmberStein #ArmandDiAggro

title: Lacey Stiles
desc: Lacey's parents frequently tell her she needs to grow up. She's teetering on the brink between party girl and socialite, has distinctly different social groups in each category, and hasn't committed to either path yet. To keep this double life in check, she calls herself Stacey whenever she's attending a highbrow affair. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #LaceyStiles

title: Kai Kahue
desc: Kai doesn't need a weight bench to workout—the world is his gym. Whether he's jogging, swimming, or competing in sports, he's never not moving. His questionable sense of social cues has yet to hold him back in life; case in point—he doesn't receive pushback (or complaints) despite his proclivity to walk around shirtless. His physique is practically a walking billboard for his side hustle of mentoring other Sims in their exercise regimens. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #KaiKahue

title: Steve Fogel
desc: Somewhere in an alternate dimension, a Steve Fogel exists that's a big-rig trucker. In this reality though, Steve has bigger career goals in mind... He dreams of being a space trucker, hauling cargo across the cosmos. It's this bold ambition that attracted his wife, June, to his side. With her healthy cooking, he will be spaceworthy in no time. As a natural goof, you may find him at a comedy club practicing his (harmless) one-liners on the crowd. #2014Sims #MaxisCreates #SteveFogel #JuneK
